summary: Backend-only testing of PixelLand MVP. Ran 21 pytest tests against the public backend URL (https://pixelland-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com/api). All 21 tests passed. Coverage includes auth (admin-login success + 2 invalid-credential cases, /auth/me with/without/invalid bearer, /auth/logout invalidation), pixels (list 400 with x in 0..19, y in 0..19, prices subset of [5,10,20,30,40,50,100], single GET, 404), buy flow (coins & pixels_owned correctly decremented/incremented, persistence verified via GET), 409 on already-owned, owner PATCH name/description/cover, /profile/pixels listing admin-owned, and admin endpoints (RBAC 401 when missing bearer, users list excludes password_hash, PATCH user updates coins/name, PATCH pixel for price/name/description, owner assignment + clearing with pixels_owned counter adjustment, 404 for unknown user/pixel).

minor.issue: Admin password is hardcoded in server.py and re-synced on every startup via seed_admin; functional but reduces auditability. Not a bug, just a note.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 507 lines is fine but starting to consolidate auth/pixels/admin in one file - consider splitting if it grows further.

Buy flow uses two separate updates (pixel + user) without a transaction; race-condition-safe only because of the {owner_id: None} filter on the pixel update, but the user $inc still happens even if the pixel update matched 0 docs in an unlikely race. Consider checking the update result before debiting coins.
admin clear-owner path: in admin_update_pixel, when owner_id == '' is passed but pixel currently has no owner, no-op is fine - verified.
seed_data_creation: Tests reuse seeded admin user and 400 seeded pixels. Each run buys 1 pixel as admin then clears via admin endpoint; admin coins restored to 99999 at end. Pixel names with TEST_ prefix may remain on the pixel that was bought-then-released (cosmetic).
